# Part 1: Data Ingestion and Cleaning

```{r data-loading-and-cleaning}

# Function to load, filter, and apply specific transformations to data from a folder
process_data_folder <- function(config) {
  path <- config$path
  csv_files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(csv_files) == 0) return(tibble())

  # Use a list to collect processed dataframes, which is safer for row-binding
  all_data_list <- list()

  # Loop through each file individually to handle potential inconsistencies
  for (i in seq_along(csv_files)) {
    file <- csv_files[i]
    
    header <- tryCatch(read_csv(file, n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(header) || !"Finish.timesOff" %in% names(header)) {
      cat("Skipping file (missing Finish.timesOff):", basename(file), "\n")
      next
    }
    
    data <- tryCatch(read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(data)) {
      cat("Skipping file (read error):", basename(file), "\n")
      next
    }

    # FIX: Proactively coerce all potentially problematic ID and text columns to character
    # to prevent type mismatches during the bind_rows operation.
    cols_to_character <- c(
      "participant", "bruinID.text", "textboxAge.text", "textboxAge_2.text",
      "textboxBirthday.text", "textboxCountry.text", "textboxQuestion2.text",
      "textboxQuestion3.text"
    )
    
    for (col in cols_to_character) {
      if (col %in% names(data)) {
        data <- data %>% mutate(!!sym(col) := as.character(!!sym(col)))
      }
    }
    
    # Assign new participant IDs if required (for _O folders)
    if (!is.null(config$assign_id) && config$assign_id) {
      # This logic now correctly adds/overwrites a participant column, even if one doesn't exist
      data$participant <- as.character(config$start_id + i)
    }
    
    # Add the processed dataframe to our list
    all_data_list[[i]] <- data
  }

  # Now, safely bind all consistent dataframes together
  if (length(all_data_list) == 0) return(tibble())
  df <- bind_rows(all_data_list)

  # Exclude specified participants
  if (length(config$exclude) > 0) {
    df <- df %>% filter(!(participant %in% config$exclude))
  }
  
  # Add Study and Age Group labels
  df <- df %>% mutate(Study = config$study, agegroup = config$age)

  return(df)
}
```

# Part 2: Feature Engineering

```{r feature-engineering}

# Function to tag experimental blocks (Pre/Post)
tag_chunks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    mutate(
      is_na_row = is.na(emails),
      chunk = cumsum(lag(is_na_row, default = FALSE)) + 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-is_na_row)
}

# Create the final analysis dataframe 'all_df'
all_df <- all_data_combined_all %>%
  select(any_of(c("participant", "button_selections_1", "confidence_scale_email.response", 
                  "personal_rel_scale.response", "curiosity_scale.response", "emails", 
                  "type", "Study", "agegroup", "textboxAge.text"))) %>%
  tag_chunks() %>%
  rename(Time = chunk) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = case_when(
      Time == 7  ~ "Pre",
      Time %in% c(12, 15, 22) ~ "Post",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Response = if_else(str_detect(button_selections_1, "legit"), "legit", "scam")
  ) %>%
  # FIX: Replace aggressive na.omit() with a targeted filter.
  # This keeps all trial rows, even if optional ratings are NA.
  filter(!is.na(Time)) %>%
  select(-button_selections_1) %>%
  mutate(
    accurate = if_else(type == Response, 1, 0),
    SDT = case_when(
      type == "scam"  & Response == "scam"  ~ "Hit",
      type == "scam"  & Response == "legit" ~ "Miss",
      type == "legit" & Response == "legit" ~ "Correct_R",
      type == "legit" & Response == "scam"  ~ "False_A",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Standardize (Z-score) continuous predictors for model stability
all_df <- all_df %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_z = as.numeric(scale(confidence_scale_email.response)),
    personal_rel_z = as.numeric(scale(personal_rel_scale.response)),
    curiosity_z = as.numeric(scale(curiosity_scale.response))
  )

# Save the final, analysis-ready dataframe
write.csv(all_df, "all_df_SLSI_for_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Clean up
rm(tag_chunks)

    )
  )

age_df <- age_df %>% drop_na()
```

# Part 3: Statistical Modeling

```{r statistical-modeling}

# --- D-Prime Model ---
# First, create the dprime summary dataframe
dprime_df_counts <- all_df %>%
  count(participant, Time, Study, agegroup, SDT) %>%  
  pivot_wider(names_from = SDT, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

dprime <- function(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R) {
  hit_rate <- (Hit + 0.5) / (Hit + Miss + 1)
  fa_rate  <- (False_A + 0.5) / (False_A + Correct_R + 1)
  qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate)
}

dprime_df <- dprime_df_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(d_prime = dprime(
    Hit = ifelse("Hit" %in% names(.), Hit, 0),
    Miss = ifelse("Miss" %in% names(.), Miss, 0),
    False_A = ifelse("False_A" %in% names(.), False_A, 0),
    Correct_R = ifelse("Correct_R" %in% names(.), Correct_R, 0)
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

c_criterion <- function(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R) {
  # Compute hit rate and false alarm rate with the 0.5 correction
  hit_rate <- (Hit + 0.5) / (Hit + Miss + 1)
  fa_rate  <- (False_A + 0.5) / (False_A + Correct_R + 1)
  
  # Compute z-scores
  z_hit <- qnorm(hit_rate)
  z_fa  <- qnorm(fa_rate)
  
  # Compute c criterion
  c <- -0.5 * (z_hit + z_fa)
  return(c)
}

# Apply row-wise to your dataframe
c_criterion_df <- dprime_df_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(c_criterion = c_criterion(
    Hit = ifelse("Hit" %in% names(.), Hit, 0),
    Miss = ifelse("Miss" %in% names(.), Miss, 0),
    False_A = ifelse("False_A" %in% names(.), False_A, 0),
    Correct_R = ifelse("Correct_R" %in% names(.), Correct_R, 0)
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

load("/Users/kyliealberts/SLSI/scales_scored.RData")

dprime_df$Study <- as.factor(dprime_df$Study)
dprime_df$Time <- as.factor(dprime_df$Time)
dprime_df$agegroup <- as.factor(dprime_df$agegroup)
model_dprime <- lmer(d_prime ~ Study*Time*agegroup + (1 | participant), data = dprime_df)
print("--- D-Prime Model Summary ---")
summary(model_dprime)
```

```{r}
#a prime model
aprime <- function(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R) {
  hit_rate <- (Hit + 0.5) / (Hit + Miss + 1)
  fa_rate  <- (False_A + 0.5) / (False_A + Correct_R + 1)
  
  # A-prime formula
  0.5 + ((hit_rate - fa_rate) * (1 + hit_rate - fa_rate)) / 
    (4 * hit_rate * (1 - fa_rate))
}

# Apply across rows
aprime_df <- dprime_df_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(a_prime = aprime(
    Hit = ifelse("Hit" %in% names(.), Hit, 0),
    Miss = ifelse("Miss" %in% names(.), Miss, 0),
    False_A = ifelse("False_A" %in% names(.), False_A, 0),
    Correct_R = ifelse("Correct_R" %in% names(.), Correct_R, 0)
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

b_double_prime <- function(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R) {
  hit_rate <- (Hit + 0.5) / (Hit + Miss + 1)
  fa_rate  <- (False_A + 0.5) / (False_A + Correct_R + 1)
  
  (hit_rate * (1 - hit_rate) - fa_rate * (1 - fa_rate)) /
    (hit_rate * (1 - hit_rate) + fa_rate * (1 - fa_rate))
}

b_double_prime <- dprime_df_counts %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(b_double_prime = b_double_prime(
    Hit = ifelse("Hit" %in% names(.), Hit, 0),
    Miss = ifelse("Miss" %in% names(.), Miss, 0),
    False_A = ifelse("False_A" %in% names(.), False_A, 0),
    Correct_R = ifelse("Correct_R" %in% names(.), Correct_R, 0)
  )) %>%
  ungroup()


aprime_df <- merge(aprime_df, ss_df, by = "participant")

write.csv(aprime_df, "aprime_df.csv")


aprime_df$Study <- as.factor(aprime_df$Study)
aprime_df$Time <- as.factor(aprime_df$Time)
aprime_df$agegroup <- as.factor(aprime_df$agegroup)
model_aprime <- lmer(a_prime ~ Study*Time*agegroup + total_ss_answer + (1 | participant), data = aprime_df)
print("--- A-Prime Model Summary ---")
summary(model_aprime)
```

# Part 5: Visualization

```{r visualization}
# --- Confidence vs. Accuracy Scatter Plots ---
average_confidence_accuracy <- all_df %>%
  group_by(participant, Study, type) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accurate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_confidence = mean(confidence_scale_email.response, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

figure_accuracy_con_legit <- ggplot(
  subset(average_confidence_accuracy, type == "legit"), 
  aes(x = mean_accuracy, y = mean_confidence, color = Study)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Accuracy", y = "Confidence", title = "Legit Emails: Confidence vs. Accuracy") +
  theme_classic()
print(figure_accuracy_con_legit)

figure_accuracy_con_scam <- ggplot(
  subset(average_confidence_accuracy, type == "scam"), 
  aes(x = mean_accuracy, y = mean_confidence, color = Study)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Accuracy", y = "Confidence", title = "Scam Emails: Confidence vs. Accuracy") +
  theme_classic()
print(figure_accuracy_con_scam)


# --- Bar Chart of Accuracy ---
average_df <- all_df %>% 
  group_by(type, Time, Study) %>% 
  summarise(accurate = mean(accurate), .groups = "drop")

figure_accuracy <- ggplot(average_df, aes(x = type, y = accurate, fill = Time)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(), col = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Study) +
  labs(x = "Email Type", y = "Mean Accuracy", title = "Accuracy by Email Type, Time, and Study") +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(0, 1)
print(figure_accuracy)

# Clean up
rm(average_confidence_accuracy, average_df, figure_accuracy_con_legit, figure_accuracy_con_scam, figure_accuracy)
```
